title: Evaluating Agents Across Runtime Contracts: When Mismatch Costs Efficiency or Quality
abstract: arXiv:2603.01209v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In CodeAct, language-model agents write Python that calls tools and use execution feedback to choose actions. Persistent runtimes preserve Python variables between actions; stateless runtimes clear them without resetting task progress. Training traces demonstrate task-solving strategies and runtime-specific ways to store and recover intermediate results. We study runtime transfer: whether agents trained under one contract remain effective under the other, a dependence that fixed-runtime evaluations can conceal. Across three tasks requiring a working record built from tool feedback, we fine-tune separate Qwen3-8B agents per task and runtime on instance-paired persistent and stateless traces and evaluate all four training-deployment combinations. We vary the per-turn tool-call cap: how many calls one Python action may execute. In our primary task, agents inspect hidden item attributes and select a high-value subset under a weight limit

translated_title: 评估跨运行时契约的智能体：失配何时损害效率或质量
translated_abstract: 在CodeAct中，语言模型智能体编写调用工具的Python代码，并利用执行反馈来选择动作。持久化运行时在动作之间保留Python变量；无状态运行时则清除这些变量但不重置任务进度。训练轨迹展示了任务求解策略以及特定于运行时的存储和恢复中间结果的方法。我们研究运行时迁移：在一种契约下训练的智能体在另一种契约下是否仍然有效——这种依赖性在固定运行时的评估中可能被掩盖。在三个需要根据工具反馈构建工作记录的任务中，我们针对每个任务和运行时分别微调Qwen3-8B智能体，使用实例配对的持久化和无状态轨迹进行训练，并评估所有四种训练-部署组合。我们改变每轮工具调用上限：即一个Python动作可以执行多少次调用。在我们的主要任务中，智能体检查隐藏的物品属性，并在重量限制下选择高价值子集。
tldr: 该论文首次系统研究了CodeAct智能体在持久化与无状态两种运行时契约之间的迁移能力，揭示了固定运行时评估会掩盖智能体对训练运行时的依赖，且契约失配会损害效率或质量。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies runtime transfer of CodeAct agents between persistent and stateless runtime contracts, revealing that fixed-runtime evaluations can conceal agents' dependence on their training runtime, with contract mismatch costing efficiency or quality.
